# Ideal Automation (concept by Kerblabs)

> Home automation and audio video company in Phoenix, AZ. Facts from myidealav.com. This is an unofficial concept page.

## Services
Lighting design and control, whole-home automation, audio and video, home theater and media rooms, motorized shades, security and surveillance, networking and Wi-Fi, pool and outdoor control, climate and energy, custom control and touchpanels, structured wiring and pre-wire.

## Service area (per their site)
Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Arcadia, Biltmore, Cave Creek, Carefree, Fountain Hills, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Tucson.
